description: Expressive English and Mandarin TTS. Clones a voice from a short clip, designs one from a written description, or keeps a cloned voice and directs its tone, emotion and pace. Inline vocal events such as (laugh), (sigh) or [笑]. 24 kHz mono, needs a 12 GB GPU. BreezeBlue Research and Non-Commercial License.

workerSettings.label: Fast path (CUDA graphs)
workerSettings.description: About 5x faster (RTF ~0.6 instead of ~3 on an RTX 3090) for ~1 GB more VRAM and ~20 s more loading time. Turn it off if loading fails on your GPU.

settings.label: Voice description / direction
settings.description: Without a reference clip: describes the voice, e.g. "A warm, thoughtful young woman with a calm, reflective delivery." With a clip: directs it, e.g. "Speak slowly with a restrained, serious tone." Write it in the language of the text.

settings.label: Reference transcript
settings.description: Cloning: the exact words spoken in the reference clip, repetitions included. Leave empty to have Whisper transcribe it (downloads Whisper the first time, 1.6 GB).

settings.label: Instruction strength
settings.description: Classifier-free guidance, used only with a description or direction. 4 is upstream's recommendation; higher follows the instruction more closely.
